facts.business: The company is a Non-Deposit taking Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC-ND) engaged in short term and long term financing to corporate and non-corporate entities, with a focus on recovery of overdue receivables.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is confident of doing better business in the form of short term and long term financing (both secured and unsecured).

key_risks: Impairment of financial assets (expected credit losses) on loan receivables
Increase in borrowings affecting interest coverage ratio
Increase in current liabilities affecting current ratio
Dependence on RBI regulations and compliance
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act where applicable and details have been disclosed in the Financial Statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
